fix: scoring weights across the playlist strategies (#92)

* fix: scoring weights across the playlist strategies

- Deep cuts: max 3 tracks per artist, position bonus capped at 0.15,
  alternate takes / live albums / compilations / deluxe repeats skipped,
  artists weighted by play weight
- Mood: the mood's energy target is finally used (0.5 genre + 0.35 energy
  fit + 0.15 taste); off-energy tracks rank last
- Constellation: discover via similar artists, search only as fallback;
  short zones are backfilled
- Trend: rank weight relative to chart length; artist cap
- Refresh: newest albums first; artist cap
- Daily pick: exclude disliked songs, add taste match, halve the jitter
- Compatibility: era overlap weighted by listening share
- Honour config excluded_artists / preferred_genres; new
  avoid_repeat_days skips tracks from recent DJ playlists
- One shared copy of the genre adjacency helpers in _common.py

Fixes #61

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: address review on scoring weights (#92)

- Daily pick scores candidates before the user filters, so
  preferred_genres can boost them
- Title keys keep Unicode letters, so non-Latin titles stay distinct
- Deep cuts stop scanning only when filtered candidates under the
  album and artist caps can fill the list
- _cap_per_artist applies the 2-per-album cap, matching sequence_tracks
- Trend never returns more tracks than requested
- Constellation ranks each zone by preferred-genre match and no

fix(compatibility): genre overlap no longer deflates scores (#59)

genre_overlap_score weighted each genre's match by its weight twice, so
a profile vs itself scored 75% and a ten-genre listener matched
themselves at 0.2; Muse rated a 32% "Stretch pick" for an
Alternative/Rock listener.

Profile and blend comparisons now use a normalised weighted histogram
intersection with half credit within a genre family, averaged over both
directions so the score is symmetric. Artist compatibility uses a new
artist_genre_affinity: the listener's weight for each of the artist's
genres relative to their top genre. Tests pin identity = 1.0, scale
freedom, symmetry, family credit and the Muse case.

Closes #59

fix: skip HTTPServer's reverse-DNS lookup in the local servers (#79)

HTTPServer.server_bind() calls socket.getfqdn(host), and on macOS CI
runners resolving 127.0.0.1 hangs ~35 s per process. The --durations
output showed it: three test setups at 35.0 s each (first server per
xdist worker) and the demo end-to-end tests at 72.9 s and 38.3 s (each
spawned demo.py process paid it again). Users of demo.py serve and
setup_auth.py on such Macs waited too.

MockAppleMusic and TokenCatcher now use a LoopbackHTTPServer that binds
without the lookup. Regression tests make getfqdn raise; they fail on
the old code and pass now.
